# Readflow

> Markdown publishing platform with a public API and CLI for AI agents.

## Quick Start — npm package

```bash
npm i readflow-md
```

Use the CLI to share markdown files directly from your repo or CI pipeline:

```bash
npx readflow-md share README.md
npx readflow-md share --title "My Doc" ./docs/guide.md
```

## API

POST https://readflow.aranish.uk/api/share
Content-Type: application/json

Request body:
- content (string, required): Raw markdown content
- title (string, optional): Document title (max 100 chars)

Response (200):
- id: Document ID
- url: Shareable read-only URL (https://readflow.aranish.uk/s/{id})

Errors: 400 (invalid content), 429 (rate limited, 25/hr/IP), 500 (server error)

## Example

```bash
curl -X POST https://readflow.aranish.uk/api/share \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"content": "# Hello\n\nWorld", "title": "Hello"}'
```

## Full docs

- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/readflow-md
- Full API docs: https://readflow.aranish.uk/agents.md
